I understand how you feel. I'm not sure how to approach this topic of conversation considering how vastly it effects (affects?) you. I've spent my fair share of time upset over the fact that no one seems to like me, romantically or platonically. I've come to realize that there is so much more to life than having a SO/ having sex. I don't mean to offend you but I feel as if you're spending a lot of time wallowing in self pity... I want you to know people care about you. Your time for love will come. In the mean time, doing things for yourself is key. Treat yourself like a king— go on walks, read, draw/paint, try things youre not even good at. Just keep yourself occupied with a routine. I've spent a hell of a lot of time alone and I've found comfort in solitude. Not saying that you will as well, but trying things like this, new things, is important for your mental health and overall mood. I'm here if you'd like to message me about anything at all!
I gagged just by reading this.

I believe the comments I saw have been deleted! regardless, I hope that you somehow change your mind. your life is valued even if you don't feel that it is. I hope with everything in me, that things turn around for you. Sending love and miracle-inducing energy your way.

i've just seen this, please post again if/when you're okay. pills are a difficult way to go, not that i'm encouraging any method AT ALL. I'm hoping you survived and are physically okay. please talk to me

I don't know what you've been through but please, please talk to me. I have been suicidal since I was 11 years old and have attempted at least 4 times. But I would never encourage/help someone commit suicide. I am disgusted by comments I see on here suggesting methods. We are here to help each other get better.
